title: Factor shared hybrid double-buffer core; integrate fallback semantics into checkpointed sweep
description:
## Goal

Eliminate the sanctioned-at-review duplication between the two hybrid
double-buffer worker loops, and make the checkpointed sweep's
failure-mode semantics an explicit, tested design decision rather than
an omission.

## Context

Created 2026-06-11 during the C.2 lead review (571c11c4 adversarial
pre-review HIGH-2; recorded elimination plan). Task under epic
`gf2-sim` (`f9717e7e`); intentionally NOT a child of story `9e853c62`
(the story's deliverables are complete; this is quality debt across
the landed C surfaces, scheduled post-C).

`executor/drain.rs::worker_round_hybrid` re-implements the C.1
double-buffer worker protocol (`executor/scheduler.rs::worker_partition_hybrid`:
prep closure, `thread::scope` overlap, decode, BCH decode-tail/record
loop). The copies have already diverged intentionally:

- The checkpointed path has NO `dispatch_with_fallback`/`strict_gpu`
  handling — sanctioned at the time (failure wiring was `42eac5cc`'s
  concurrent scope) and determinism-motivated: a CPU-fallback frame
  folded into a checkpoint would break resume byte-identity unless the
  fallback decision itself is deterministic and resume-stable.
- The checkpointed path has no `traced_interval` span instrumentation.

The interim contract (documented on `Pipeline::run_checkpointed` /
`run_sweep_checkpointed` by the 571c11c4 fix round): a recoverable GPU
fault ABORTS the checkpointed sweep (resumably) instead of
substituting the CPU fallback.

## Deliverables

1. One shared double-buffer core (parameterized by per-batch hooks:
   decode dispatch, instrumentation, drain brackets) used by BOTH
   `worker_partition_hybrid` and `worker_round_hybrid`; behavior of
   each caller byte-identical to before the refactor.
2. An explicit, documented decision on checkpointed-sweep fallback
   semantics: either (a) keep abort-resumably (then make
   `dispatch_with_fallback`'s OOM arm configuration-aware so the
   checkpointed path's behavior is one policy, not a missing call), or
   (b) implement deterministic fallback-in-checkpointed-sweep (the
   fallback decision must be a pure function of recorded state so
   resume byte-identity holds; note `inject_gpu_oom_modulus` is
   result-affecting on the fallback path yet excluded from
   `config_hash` — moot only while the checkpointed runner never
   injects; resolve if (b)).
3. `traced_interval` spans on the checkpointed loop (parity with the
   uncheckpointed scheduler).
4. The drain.rs module-doc divergence note and the
   `run_checkpointed`/`run_sweep_checkpointed` doc sentences updated to
   the post-refactor truth.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] No duplicated double-buffer protocol: one shared core, both
  callers; `tests/determinism.rs`, `tests/hybrid_resume.rs`,
  `tests/hybrid_scheduler.rs` (incl. the overlap smoke) and the
  stage-driven byte-identity suites all pass unchanged (byte-identical
  columns at the pinned seeds).
- [hard] Checkpointed-sweep failure semantics are decided, implemented,
  documented, and tested (whichever of (a)/(b) is chosen, the test
  proves the documented behavior; if (b), resume byte-identity with a
  forced fallback is proven).
- [hard] `cargo-ci`, `code-review` gates green.

## Non-goals

- New failure-mode policy surface (§8 policy itself is fixed).
- Campaign-binary integration (D.2 `bbf6b6ee`).
